atoms.a: Why would a colon be used in a sentence?
b: to indicate the end of a paragraph

instruction.text: Complete the sentences by adding the correct punctuation.

atoms.b: The house was in an awful condition and needed to be renovated((++: --.)) it hadn’t been lived in for years((--: ++.))
atoms.sound: The house was in an awful condition and needed to be renovated: it hadn’t been lived in for years.

atoms.b: My friend and I love detective books and films((--: ++.)) We watched a new film yesterday and immediately guessed who the killer was((++: --.)) as always, it was the person we least expected((--: ++.))
atoms.sound: My friend and I love detective books and films. We watched a new film yesterday and immediately guessed who the killer was: as always, it was the person we least expected.

atoms.b: A few months ago, I entered a poetry competition((--: ++.)) Today, I found out that I won, and I can’t wait to tell my family((++: --.)) I know they’ll be so proud of me.
atoms.sound: A few months ago, I entered a poetry competition. Today, I found out that I won, and I can’t wait to tell my family: I know they’ll be so proud of me.

atoms.b: When boarding a flight, it’s important to take notice of the safety demonstration and to remember((++: --.)) safety first((--: ++.))
atoms.sound: When boarding a flight, it’s important to take notice of the safety demonstration and to remember: safety first.

instruction.text: Drag the colon to the correct place in the text.

atoms.b: I have always loved music((++:))I’ve been playing multiple instruments since I was young.
atoms.sound: I have always loved music: I’ve been playing multiple instruments since I was young.

atoms.b: My cousins and I have finally decided what we want to do in summer((++:))we’re going to go camping together.
atoms.sound: My cousins and I have finally decided what we want to do in summer: we’re going to go camping together.

atoms.b: My dog stopped suddenly as he entered the park((++:)) he could smell food somewhere.
atoms.sound: My dog stopped suddenly as he entered the park: he could smell food somewhere.

atoms.b: Make sure to bring a warm jacket with you to the festival((++:))we’ll be spending a lot of time outside.
atoms.sound: Make sure to bring a warm jacket with you to the festival: we’ll be spending a lot of time outside.
